WHO WINS WHEN A
BUSINESS IS BOUGHT?

caption:
Your town. Their exit plan?

Who should a business work for?

Our view: the people who shop there and the people who work there belong in the story—not just investors.

At @PEUnderScrutiny, we will ask who owns the business, how a deal was financed, and what actually changed for customers and workers. A buyout alone does not prove harm. We will check the evidence and label opinion clearly.

What should we investigate first: healthcare, housing or everyday services? Comment your pick.

#PrivateEquity #WorkersRights #ConsumerRights #Competition

voiceover_optional.text: Who wins when a business in your town gets bought?
Investors, customers, and workers can have different priorities.
We ask who owns it, how the deal was funded, and what changed.
A buyout alone is not a verdict. We check the evidence.
What should we investigate first? Follow PE Under Scrutiny.
